description: A Kivy-based Python script demonstrating advanced collision detection and mesh creation with custom polygon and shape classes, including collision handling and visualization.

classes.name: BaseShape
classes.description: A base widget class for movable polygon shapes with collision detection and visual debugging features.

classes.name: RegularShape
classes.description: A subclass of BaseShape that creates regular polygons (triangles, squares, pentagons, etc.) with mesh rendering.

classes.name: MeshShape
classes.description: A subclass of BaseShape that creates convex mesh shapes from custom points, supporting touch and shape collision detection.

classes.name: Collisions
classes.description: A Kivy App class managing shape instances, performing collision detection (circle-to-circle), and dispatching collision events.

methods.name: move_label
methods.description: Moves the label displaying the shape's name to a specified position.

methods.name: move_collider
methods.description: Moves the debug collider points when the shape moves.

methods.name: on_debug_collider
methods.description: Updates the length of the debug collider points array.

methods.name: on_pos
methods.description: Handles position changes, moving polygon points, label, collider, and mesh accordingly.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Handles dragging to move the shape based on touch input.

methods.name: collision_circles
methods.description: Detects collisions between circle-shaped shapes based on center distance, optionally visualizing colliders.

methods.name: on_collision
methods.description: Event handler dispatched when two shapes collide.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the scene with multiple shapes, positions them randomly, and schedules collision checks.
